messages.subject: Empty Chart - Exception
parts:
Hi @all,

it is not really a ggplot2-issue, but occasionally I got different
error-messages on different platforms when I use
png(...) and ggplot2. These error-messages cause empty png-files with
white background.
My question :

Is there a opportunity to throw exceptions when an error messages
within the png(...) dev.off() - body occurs ?

like :

plot <- ggplot(...)
if is.empty(plot)
plot <- ggplot(...)
plot

Thanks in Advance and best Regards,

Ed

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Empty Chart - Exception
parts:
Hi Ed,

There's no easy way to do this as far as I know. Possibly you could
inspect the content of the file and check if it's non-null.

Hadley
